summary: FAIL. Three blocking defects stand on real inputs. The panel script refuses 3 of the 5 real drawings and measures the whole figure as the head (F1). The Lily side-chin guard misses antialiased hair (F2). The cast sheet skips the head-fit rule and records no crop state (F3). Fourteen nonblocking findings follow (F4 to F17). Deviation 1 (eye width 0.6) breaks a stated rule and deviation 2 (nearest-neighbour) breaks only the convention text; neither is a Blocker and neither makes a false pass. The 81 recorded passing cases reproduce, the Mom rows and hashes match the plan, and the crown rule and the symbolic-link destination checks hold. Green routes the three Blockers; the spec owner decides F4, F5 and F12. A new round runs after the fix.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: scripts/sprout-cast-panel.mjs cannot write panels for 3 of the 5 real drawings. A real run on docs/sprout-mockups exits 1 with 'figure wider than its cell' for Grandma, Grandpa and Lily; Dad and Tom pass by accident. Cause 1 (headBand, lines 148-159): the chin is the row where the widest run jumps above 1.5 times the head width, but a chibi head is wider than its shoulders (headToShoulders 1.11 to 2.35), so the 'chin' is the sole row for Grandma, Grandpa, Tom and Lily and row 82 for Dad (a 3-row head band). The head-fit rule thus measures the whole figure or 3 rows, not crown to chin (page chin rows: Dad 435, Grandma 572, Grandpa 495, Tom 583, Lily 574). Cause 2 (maskOf, lines 97-108): any pixel with a channel at or below 245 counts as ink, so JPEG noise (32 to 61 isolated pixels in each head band) widens the extent; Grandpa's head band spans x 0 to 1015 and the window centre follows the noise. This blocks the panel step of T7, T8 and T14 and AC7.1 and AC7.5. The Red drawings are transparent PNG files with a head narrower than the body, so no test saw it. Fix: measure the head from the crown to a fixed chin row for each drawing (add a DRAWING_CHINS constant from the page and amend decision (n)); build the ink mask from the largest 8-connected component or drop isolated pixels; centre the window on the head axis; add a Red case that runs the five real drawings or opaque noisy JPEG fixtures with a head wider than the shoulders.

F2 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: the Lily side-chin guard in scripts/proportion-check.mjs (lines 656 and 684) is blind to antialiased edges. isHair() demands alpha 250 or more, but the guard samples the frontmost pixel of the alpha-128 mask. On the real Mom flat side render that pixel is fully opaque in only 243 of 600 rows. Probe: a hair-coloured frontmost pixel at alpha 255 or 250 gives 'GUARD lily side chin: hair at the front'; alpha 249, 200 or 128 gives no guard. The spec says the frontmost pixel 'is a skin pixel, not a hair pixel', but the code tests only 'not hair': a blue frontmost pixel also passes. The Red fixture (tests/proportion-cast-options.test.ts:266-269) uses alpha 255 only. Fix: read the colour of the frontmost pixel by the same alpha-128 rule as the mask, require a skin pixel, and add alpha 200 and alpha 128 fixtures.

F3 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: scripts/sprout-cast-panel.mjs writeSheet() (lines 407-456) skips two rules that spec 'The horizontal crop' applies to every sheet cell. It never refuses a head wider than the 280 px cell: a Tom front render with a 236 px head exits 1 as a panel ('figure wider than its cell: sprout-tom-kim') and exits 0 as a sheet, with the cell cropped to 279 px. It also records no crop state: neither the stdout line nor the caption names one, but AC7.5 and T17 need 'cropped: yes' or 'no' for every cell. Fix: apply the head-fit and figure-top checks inside writeSheet(), add a 'cropped: yes|no' entry for each cell to the sheet caption and to the stdout line, and pin both in tests/sprout-cast-panel.test.ts.
nonblocking_findings: F4 [Major] adversarial-testing: the face-mark guard (scripts/proportion-check.mjs:403-426) compares a mark only with variants.eyes and #14100e, but the base paints the iris at #4a2e18 (assets/parts/humanoid-kim.ts:133). The spec example glasses colour #3b2a1e is 15 from that iris, so it passes the guard, and the exclusion then deletes the iris from the eye mask (1148 of 3298 dark pixels in Mom's real eye window). A real-render run with castMeta glasses #3b2a1e or #4a2e18 prints 'eye components: found 0, expected 2', not the named 'faceMarks glasses: too close to the eye paint'. The code follows spec 'The asset metadata and the eye mask' rule 2, so the rule is incomplete. T8 (Grandpa) declares such a colour. Fix: include the rendered iris colour in the guard (derive the eye colours from the eye components of the unmarked mask), change the spec example colour, and make the glasses fixture paint the real iris colour.

F5 [Major] adversarial-testing: deviation 1 (eye-component width limit 0.6 of the head width instead of 0.4) breaks a stated spec rule. The archived redesign spec (measure/archive/chibi_sprouts_redesign_20261123/spec.md:239-241) fixes the limit at 0.40, and cast spec rule 3 says the eye window, the two-component rule and the seed do not change; Green changed the limit alone (scripts/proportion-check.mjs:606) and recorded it only in plan.md. The Red glasses-frame blob is 0.57 of the head width: with 0.40 the undeclared run prints 'found 0, expected 2', not the 'found 1' the spec requires, so the fixture and the old rule conflict and the choice was a spec call. Effect: a dark bar of 0.41 to 0.59 head width now gives 'found 3' (it was dropped before); a bar of 0.61 or more is still dropped; measurePixels() gives identical results under 0.4 and 0.6; Mom's rows do not move. No false pass exists: eyeWidthFace (0.22 to 0.24 of the face width) cannot hold when one blob is 0.4 of the head width or more. Fix: the spec owner picks one rule and records it (amend the limit to 0.60 in spec.md, or shrink the fixture blob to 0.40 or less and restore 0.4).

F6 [Major] adversarial-testing: both scripts ignore any argument that is not an exact known option, and the defaults are destructive. proportion-check: '--record=out/x.json' writes the default out/chibi-sprouts/redesign/measure.json (the file that tests/sprout-mom-kim.test.ts:449 reads) and '--table=child', '--base=humanoid-kim-child' and '--tabel child' exit 0 on the kim table. Panel: the typo '--sheat' runs --all and rewrites all five panels (a probe changed the Dad panel hash); '--root=<dir>' is ignored and the root becomes the real repository; '--date' with no value swallows the next option; '--root ""' resolves to the working directory. Fix: reject an unknown argument, a repeated option and an empty value with one named line (for example 'unknown option <arg>') before any output.

F7 [Major] adversarial-testing: spec 'The horizontal crop' rule 2 says 'A head never crops', but scripts/sprout-cast-panel.mjs:229-233 centres the window on the whole-figure mask and checks only the head width. Probe: a front render with an arm out to one side exits 0 and the head loses 79 of 340 px at the left edge. Fix: require the head extent to lie inside the window (else exit 1 with 'figure wider than its cell: <name>') or centre the window on the head axis.

F8 [Major] adversarial-testing: scripts/sprout-cast-panel.mjs:481-486 validates each asset only when it reaches it. With the Grandpa record missing, '--all' rewrote the Dad and Grandma panels (the Dad hash changed) and then exited 1 with 'record sprout-grandpa-kim: not built'. A rewritten panel has a new date, so it voids its judge record. Fix: validate every record, render and drawing for all targets before the first write, and write each file by temp file and rename.

F9 [Major] adversarial-testing: the panel caption counts the rows that exist, not 11 (scripts/sprout-cast-panel.mjs:353-366). A record with no numeric rows gives exit 0 and a panel captioned '0/0 rows pass; palms ok' (read from the PNG); a record with 2 rows gives '2/2'. The spec text is '<n>/11 rows pass'. This is a vacuous pass (A4). Fix: require the eleven table names in table order, print '/11', and exit 1 with 'record <name>: rows incomplete'.

F10 [Major] adversarial-testing: spec 'The destinations' rule 4 says one line and no stack trace, but lstatSync throws ENOTDIR when a parent is a regular file. scripts/proportion-check.mjs:1067 prints a 10-line stack for '--record out/chibi-sprouts/cast/x.json' when 'cast' is a file (the 'destination parent is a file' branch is unreachable); scripts/sprout-cast-panel.mjs:193 prints a raw 'ENOTDIR: not a directory, lstat' line when out/chibi-sprouts is a file. Nothing is written. Fix: catch ENOTDIR in the lstat walk and return 'destination parent is a file: <rel>'.

F11 [Major] adversarial-testing: the destination check uses lstat only, so a hard link inside out/ passes. A file hard-linked to an outside file was overwritten by '--record' (scripts/proportion-check.mjs:1337) and by the panel write (scripts/sprout-cast-panel.mjs:398). Fix: refuse a destination with nlink above 1 as 'destination is a link: <rel>', or write by temp file and rename.

F12 [Nit] adversarial-testing: deviation 2 (nearest-neighbour mapping instead of sharp.extract plus resize) breaks the convention text of decision (m) (spec.md:557: 'sharp.extract(box) then resize({ height, fit: fill })'), but no acceptance criterion and no behavior. Green's reason in plan T2 is wrong: an extract of band+1 rows resized to 701 rows puts the block on rows 80 to 780 exactly (probe). A valid reason exists that no record names: Dad's crown row 80 is above 8 percent of the band (116 rows), so a literal extract gets top -36 and sharp throws. Cost on the judged bytes, against a padded extract plus resize on the real Dad drawing: mean absolute difference 1.62 of 255; 1.5 percent of ink pixels differ by more than 48; 1-px lines survive 98 of 204 (2-px lines 197 of 204); a 4x crop of the face looks the same. Fix: the spec owner amends decision (m) to name clamped nearest-neighbour sampling and corrects the plan T2 reason.

F13 [Nit] adversarial-testing: --date is unvalidated (scripts/sprout-cast-panel.mjs:284 and 479). It accepts '', 'tomorrow' and '2026-13-45', crashes sharp on '&' ('Input buffer has corrupt header: glib: XML parse error'), and puts markup into the caption ('</text><text y="58">99/99 rows pass' exits 0). Fix: accept only a real YYYY-MM-DD date and XML-escape the text in textSvg().

F14 [Nit] adversarial-testing: checkRows() and measureFigure() use 'TABLES[table] ?? TABLES.kim', so a typo such as 'chlid' silently uses the kim table, and 'constructor' or '__proto__' throws 'spec.map is not a function'; TABLES is not frozen, so a mutation changes the pass decision. The spec says the selected table is authoritative. Fix: throw 'unknown table <name>: known kim, child' in the seam and deep-freeze TABLES.

F15 [Nit] adversarial-testing: hexToRgb() returns NaN for 'red', '#3b2', '#GGGGGG' and '', so the too-close guard and the exclusion are both skipped without an error, and the run fails later with a misleading 'eye components: found 1'. Fix: require /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i and fail with 'faceMarks <name>: not a colour'.

F16 [Nit] adversarial-testing: a base module without BASE_HANDS exits 1 with a stack ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading L)'); a base without BASE_CROWN_Y or BASE_CHIN_Y runs on NaN. The Phase 3 child base is new code. Fix: check the three exports after the import and exit 1 with 'base <stem>: missing <export>'.

F17 [Nit] adversarial-testing: path edge cases. A symlinked --root exits 1 with 'destination is a link:' and an empty path; '--record out/newdir/' (absent) writes a file named newdir; the panel reads input renders and drawings through symlinks (a linked drawing was embedded without complaint, and AC7.9 bans the Kim sheet, the Mom panel and LATO.2 images in a panel). Fix: print the root path in the message, reject a trailing slash on a record path, and refuse linked inputs.
evidence: Claim check A5 holds: the plan's 81 of 81 passing cases reproduce (log /tmp/opencode/adv/vitest-claim.log: Test Files 5 passed, Tests 81 passed, exit 0).

Claim check A5 holds: Mom's rows before the change (script at 5356e787) are 3.552657, 1.328305, 0.387632 and so on, and after the change 3.653929, 1.328305, 0.391841 and so on, as plan T2 records; the five Mom artifact hashes equal plan T0; prettier --check exits 0 on the five script and test files.

Crown rule holds, no finding: a mask top 2 px below the rounded projected crown passes, 3 px below gives 'GUARD top on mask: 50 vs 47'; a bun 24, 100, 300 and 500 px above passes with headHeight unchanged; Math.round gives 46.5 to 47 and 47.5 to 48.

Destination rule holds for symbolic links: a linked parent (with a file or a deep absent path), 'out' itself linked, a dangling link, a directory, an outside path, out/../escape.json and the out-evil prefix each exit 1 with the named line and an unchanged tree; the panel refuses a linked cast folder, a linked out/chibi-sprouts and a linked out. F10 and F11 are the gaps.

Table selection holds, no finding: '--table child' on Mom exits 1 with the child ranges; 'Kim', ' kim', 'kim,child', '' and 'unknown' give 'unknown table <name>: known kim, child' as one line; invalid base stems give 'unknown base <stem>'.

Panel scale holds on real input: in the real Dad panel the front, side and drawing cells end at row 780; hair and bun tops sit at rows 73 to 75, inside the headroom. The same input and date give identical bytes, and '--sheet' leaves five panels byte-identical.

Real-input run for F1: Mom's real lit renders and a real record in a scratch root /tmp/opencode/adv/rootR, with the five real drawings; node scripts/sprout-cast-panel.mjs --asset <name> --root /tmp/opencode/adv/rootR gives Dad exit 0, Grandma exit 1, Grandpa exit 1, Tom exit 0, Lily exit 1. Probe /tmp/opencode/adv/probe-e.mjs and probe-e2.mjs print the chin rows and the stray-ink counts.

End-to-end run for F4: a copy of the script and Mom's real outputs under /tmp/opencode/adv/roots/k3 with castMeta glasses #3b2a1e gives 'eye components: found 0, expected 2'; #4a2e18 gives the same; #6e4020 and #5a3a28 give the named 'too close to the eye paint'.

Evidence for F5: /tmp/opencode/adv/probe-b.mjs runs one fixture set against the repo script (0.6) and a copy with 0.4: the undeclared glasses fixture gives 'found 1' and 'found 0'; bar widths 0.41 to 0.59 give 'found 3' and no failure; measurePixels() results are identical.

Evidence for F12: /tmp/opencode/adv/probe-d.mjs (extract of band rows gives rows 80 to 779; band+1 rows resized to 701 gives 80 to 780) and probe-g.mjs (real Dad drawing: sharp throws 'Expected integer between 0 and 100000000 for top but received -36' for a literal extract; difference figures as in F12).

Fixture-to-real gaps: the real flat Mom side render has 1109 mask pixels with alpha 128 to 249; the real iris paint is #4a2e18; the real drawings are opaque JPEG files with near-white noise; the Red fixtures use alpha 255, the declared eye colour and transparent PNG drawings.

Deviation decisions: deviation 1 breaks a stated rule (spec text, no acceptance criterion, no false pass found); deviation 2 breaks the convention text of decision (m) and no behavior. Neither is a Blocker. Both need a spec-owner record (F5, F12).

T3 says 'Report-only. It changes no file', so this round adds no test. Every repro lives under /tmp/opencode/adv; no probe wrote to the audited worktree out/ tree (git status shows only the two untracked Red logs and these two result files).
